{
  "correction_rules": [
    "Adjust forecasts downward when sentiment is negative or shows early signs of bearishness (e.g., -0.25 to -0.50).",
    "Increase forecast sensitivity to recent price spikes — if price rises sharply, model should not overreact and avoid overshoots.",
    "Apply mean reversion bias: if forecast is significantly below recent 7-14 day average, gently raise it toward historical mean.",
    "When sentiment is positive (e.g., 0.50+), allow forecast to lag slightly behind true price to avoid overconfidence-driven overestimation.",
    "For long-term horizons (>10 days), reduce forecast volatility — avoid sharp upward revisions unless sentiment confirms strong bullish momentum.",
    "If true outcome consistently exceeds forecast by >5% over 3-5 days, reduce forecast bias by 10-15% for next period.",
    "In high volatility regimes (e.g., 2022-10-10 to 2022-10-25), apply smoothing filter to reduce noise in short-term forecasts."
  ]
}
